title: The Telangana Sales Tax (Settlement of Disputes) Act, 2001.
full_text: The Telangana Sales Tax (Settlement of Disputes) Act, 2001. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 200141 Act Number: 41 Enactment Date: 2001-10-15 Act Year: 2001 Short Title: The Telangana Sales Tax (Settlement of Disputes) Act, 2001. Long Title: An Act to provide for expeditious enforcement of payment of Arrear Tax, Additional Tax, Turnover Tax, Penalty or Interest in dispute under relevant Acts relating to Sales Tax, Entertainment Tax by way of settlement of such disputes and for matters connected there with or incidental thereto. Short title, extent and commencement. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. Section 5. Act not apply to certain cases. Section 6. Waiver of the tax, etc., Section 7. Competent authority. Section 8. Withdrawal of appeal, revision etc., Section 9. Eligibility for settlement. Revocation of certificate of settlement. Section 15. Power to make rules. Section 16. Repeal of Ordinance.
